# Starfall Education
> Starfall is a K-5 educational platform with interactive reading, phonics, math, books, music, and learning games for children.

Starfall Education Foundation provides child-friendly learning content for home and classroom use, with resources for students, parents, and teachers across reading, language arts, math, songs, and printable activities.

## Main Platform
- [Starfall Home](https://www.starfall.com/h/index.php): Main entry point for Starfall learning activities, grade-based content, and member access.
- [Starfall Grades](https://www.starfall.com/h/index.php): Homepage highlighting grade-level learning paths and featured educational activities.
- [Sign In](https://secure.starfall.com/memb/login1.php?signin=1): Member sign-in for accessing subscriptions, settings, and gated learning content.
- [How to Join](https://secure.starfall.com/lv/ways-to-join): Membership options and subscription information for families, classrooms, and schools.
- [Settings](https://secure.starfall.com/lv/settings): Account settings for managing preferences and member options.
- [Contact](https://secure.starfall.com/lv/contact): Contact form for support, account questions, and general inquiries.

## Parents & Teachers
- [Parent-Teacher Center](https://teach.starfall.com): Central hub for parents and teachers with lesson support and classroom resources.
- [About Starfall](https://teach.starfall.com/about): Overview of Starfall Education Foundation, mission, history, and educational approach.
- [Privacy Policy](https://teach.starfall.com/privacy): Privacy practices for Starfall services, accounts, and child-focused educational products.
- [Terms of Service](https://teach.starfall.com/terms): Terms governing use of Starfall memberships, services, and website content.
- [Parents & Teachers Home](https://teach.starfall.com): Teaching support portal for printable and instructional materials.

## Membership & Account
- [Ways to Join](https://secure.starfall.com/lv/ways-to-join): Compare membership plans and access options for home and school users.
- [Member Login](https://secure.starfall.com/memb/login1.php?signin=1): Secure login page for existing Starfall members.
- [Account Settings](https://secure.starfall.com/lv/settings): Manage account details, preferences, and subscription-related settings.
- [Contact Support](https://secure.starfall.com/lv/contact): Reach Starfall for billing, membership, or technical support questions.

## Apps & Store
- [App Catalog](https://store.starfall.com/app-catalog): Catalog of Starfall mobile apps and related educational products.
- [Starfall Store](https://store.starfall.com/): Online store for apps, educational materials, and Starfall products.
- [Apps Access Page](https://secure.starfall.com/lv/gated?forwardURL=https%3A%2F%2Fstore.starfall.com%2Fapp-catalog&returnURL=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.starfall.com%2Fh%2Findex.php): Gated access path to the Starfall app catalog for site users.
- [Store Access Page](https://secure.starfall.com/lv/gated?forwardURL=https%3A%2F%2Fstore.starfall.com%2F&returnURL=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.starfall.com%2Fh%2Findex.php&label=The%20Starfall%20Store): Gated access path to the Starfall online store.

## Accessibility & Help
- [Accessibility](https://starfall.com/h/accessibility.php?sn=main): Accessibility statement describing inclusive design and support for diverse learners.
- [Help Center](http://help.starfall.com): Help portal for common questions, troubleshooting, and support guidance.
- [Contact](https://secure.starfall.com/lv/contact): Support contact page for technical, account, and general assistance.

## Foundation & Policies
- [About](https://teach.starfall.com/about): Foundation background, educational mission, and organizational information.
- [Privacy](https://teach.starfall.com/privacy): Privacy policy for website visitors, members, and educational users.
- [Terms](https://teach.starfall.com/terms): Legal terms for use of Starfall websites, services, and memberships.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://starfall.com/h/accessibility.php?sn=main): Accessibility commitments and compliance information for Starfall platforms.

## Key User Entry Points
- [Home Learning Access](https://www.starfall.com/h/index.php): Starting point for children and families using Starfall at home.
- [Teacher Resource Center](https://teach.starfall.com): Starting point for educators seeking classroom and printable resources.
- [Membership Signup](https://secure.starfall.com/lv/ways-to-join): Entry point for purchasing or starting a Starfall membership.
- [App Catalog](https://store.starfall.com/app-catalog): Entry point for discovering Starfall apps on supported devices.
- [Help Center](http://help.starfall.com): Entry point for support documentation and troubleshooting.
